note: Preregistered criteria expressed in a form a machine can check for REACHABILITY: could any possible result have satisfied this criterion, given the bounds of the metrics it is scored on? This registry declares the criterion's shape; it never restates its meaning, and it never scores the criterion itself. Only forms listed in scripts/check_criterion_reachability.py SUPPORTED_FORMS may appear.

criteria.quoted: on the frozen EPA counterfactuals, interval accounting has no higher false-confident-error rate than head count at every injected shift, with at least one shift lower by `0.05` or more
criteria.floorBasis: A false-confident-error rate is a proportion of cases and cannot fall below zero. The floor is a property of the metric, declared here rather than inferred.
